description: Monthly time series 2015-2025 (about 130 monthly values) for one variable at a point, plus the 12-month climatology. Accumulation variables are monthly totals: precipitation_mm and total_evaporation_mm in mm/month (evaporation positive), snowfall_cm in cm/month, net_solar_radiation_mj_m2 and net_thermal_radiation_mj_m2 in MJ/m2/month. Net thermal is negative when the surface loses heat. Sum 12 months for an annual total. Other variables are monthly means (temperatures in C, pressure in hPa, wind speed in m/s, humidity and cloud cover in %, soil water as volume fraction, ndvi unitless, fire_weather_index as FWI). The response carries a unit string. Use for trend questions (is it getting hotter or drier here?). Wind direction is not available as a time series.
name: get_climate_timeseries
title: Climate time series
